publication.CAPTURE.json: byte-exact capture summary; contains no credentials or private network fields
publication.UART_CHUNKS.jsonl: byte-exact host time/length/tail metadata; no UART payload

UART_PRESTOP.sanitized.log.selection: All parsed pre-STOP lines subject to heartbeat/ROM/reset allowlist; host timestamps preserved

publication.UART_TAIL_SELECTED.sanitized.log: Selected source/profile/actor/ready/heartbeat/resource lines only; all other boot/network payload omitted. These are observations after STOP, not qualified boot PASS.
publication.excluded: Full raw UART, complete tail, host socket addresses, private artifact paths/readbacks, MAC and network configuration; no HAR created.
